subject: AWS Marketplace private offer: term length, PO workflow, and DevOps onboarding
messages:
From: Alex Hunter <alex.hunter@acmeops.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Singh <monica.singh@acmeops.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Private Offer questions and shortened PO term

Vanessa —

Thanks for the call earlier. A couple quick items from our procurement and engineering teams as we scope the PO: 1) We prefer a 12-month invoice term (our finance cycles) — is there flexibility to make the private offer 12 months with quarterly billing? 2) Our DevOps team needs clarity on onboarding: VPC endpoints, IAM roles required, and whether there are any connectivity prerequisites for Dedicated capacity. 3) Also attaching a rough SOW for the onboarding tasks.

Can your team confirm whether a 12-month term will affect the pricing/discount level or co-sell eligibility with AWS? Procurement may also need a copy of SOC2 evidence.

Appreciate it —
Alex
Director of Cloud Ops
AcmeOps, Inc.

Attachments: SOW-DevOps-Onboarding.docx
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Hunter <alex.hunter@acmeops.com>; Monica Singh <monica.singh@acmeops.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-28T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer questions and shortened PO term

Alex —

Great questions, thanks for the details and for sharing the SOW. Quick answers up front: 1) We can accommodate 12 months, but pricing tiers change at 12 vs 24+ month commitments — I’ll outline the delta below and include the exact private-offer PDF. 2) DevOps onboarding for Private/Dedicated: VPC peering or PrivateLink depending on your org requirements; we’ll provide an IAM role template and a runbook for network setup. 3) SOC2 summary attached.

I’m copying Vivek and Karthik to confirm co-sell credit implications and the legal side for PO language / billing cadence. If procurement needs a vendor contact for the invoice, we can add our finance alias.

Next step: I’ll pull the 12-month private-offer variant and send a clean PO to your procurement mailing list for routing.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_AWS_PO_PrivOffer_20260928.pdf, SOC2_summary.xlsx
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-28T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer questions and shortened PO term

Team —

Thanks for looping me in. A couple notes: if we move the customer to a 12-month term and keep the same spend profile, AWS co-sell credit percentage may be reduced compared to a 24-month commit. We should check the marketplace listing tagging (partner_id) to ensure eligibility; legal needs to confirm whether our standard private-offer T&Cs allow quarterly billing on a 12-month PO or if that triggers a billing exception.

Action items for this thread:
- Vanessa: confirm the 12-month pricing row and send the adjusted private-offer PDF for signature.
- Karthik: confirm any legal flags on the billing cadence and quick redlines for procurement.
- Laura: please prepare a short ops runbook (network checklist + expected timeline) we can attach to the PO.

If procurement requires an SLA tweak for Dedicated pools (latency SLO), that will need leadership approval — flag here and I’ll escalate.

-Vivek
Head of Marketplace & Partnerships

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Alex Hunter <alex.hunter@acmeops.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer questions and shortened PO term

Alex / Vanessa —

Reviewed the proposed PO language and the quarterly billing request. Legal is OK with a 12-month term and quarterly invoicing as long as: 1) payment terms net-30 remain, 2) we include standard termination-for-convenience with 30-day notice and a pro-rata refund clause for pre-paid credits, and 3) any SLA modifications are explicitly scoped in an attachment.

Two redline items I added to the private-offer PDF (see attached): a clause clarifying data residency commitments and an export control paragraph. Also need procurement to sign the vendor W-9 (US tax requirement) — can you confirm that will be provided?

Karithk (typo intentionally fix?) Wait must ensure name spelled Karthik. Keep correct.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Hunter <alex.hunter@acmeops.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmeops.com, Monica Singh <monica.singh@acmeops.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer questions and shortened PO term

On Wed, Sep 29, 2026 at 09:04 AM karthik_iyer@redwood.ai wrote:
> Alex / Vanessa —
>
> Reviewed the proposed PO language and the quarterly billing request. Legal is OK with a 12-month term and quarterly invoicing as long as: 1) payment terms net-30 remain, 2) we include standard termination-for-convenience with 30-day notice and a pro-rata refund clause for pre-paid credits, and 3) any SLA modifications are explicitly scoped in an attachment.

Thanks Karthik — procurement confirms W-9 and vendor information are available; I attached procurement's PO template for your finance team to review. Two questions from our engineering lead: 1) timeline for the VPC/PrivateLink setup (they want a target date; do you have a runbook lead time?), 2) will switching to quarterly billing change the invoice payer name/PO reference?

We’re targeting an internal approval by next Thursday; if we can get the adjusted PO and the ops runbook, procurement will circulate for signatures.

Alex

Attachments: AcmeOps_PO_Template.pdf
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Hunter <alex.hunter@acmeops.com>, procurement@acmeops.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-30T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer questions and shortened PO term

Alex / team —

Attached is the adjusted 12-month private offer (PDF) with the legal redlines Karthik suggested and the ops runbook Laura drafted. Short answers: 
- Ops runbook ETA: Laura's team estimates 7 business days for initial PrivateLink setup and validation once we receive network contact details; we'll add a checklist to the SOW and include a named runbook owner.
- Billing/PO references: quarterly invoices will reference the same PO number; our finance alias (invoices@redwood.ai) will be set as the payee contact to match your AP requirements.
- Co-sell: Vivek confirmed we can keep the marketplace tagging; co-sell credit tiers are slightly lower for 12-months but we will not lose eligibility.

If this looks good I’ll start the DocuSign flow and copy your procurement alias. Fingers crossed for approval next week — happy to hop on a call if you want to walk the legal redlines live.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_AWS_PO_PrivOffer_20260930_12m.pdf, SOW-DevOps-Onboarding-final.docx
